title: Variational and Annealing-Based Approaches to Quantum Combinatorial Optimization
summary: In this work, we review quantum approaches to combinatorial optimization, with the aim of bridging theoretical developments and industrial relevance. We first survey the main families of quantum algorithms, including Quantum Annealing, the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL), and Quantum Generative Modeling (QGM). We then examine the problem classes where quantum technologies currently show evidence of quantum advantage, drawing on established benchmarking initiatives such as QOBLIB, QUARK, QASMBench, and QED-C.
